skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze approaches to climate change adaptation in urban planning and management.
Analyze and apply urban planning strategies in response to climate change.
Understand and analyze approaches to climate change mitigation in urban settings.
Apply economic principles to climate change mitigation and adaptation in urban contexts.
Analyze and evaluate policies related to urban development and climate change.
Develop independent research skills to gather, synthesize, and present scientific information from multiple sources.
Collaborate effectively in group settings to complete research and presentation tasks.
Effectively present research findings and respond to questions about the presented content.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve problems related to urban climate change issues.
Understand and apply economic principles to urban development and climate change issues.
